name: Hiuen Tsiang Tourist Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Functionally the only sit-down restaurant in Sirpur village — the in-house dining at the Chhattisgarh Tourism resort that sits ~800m / 18-minute walk from Lakshmana Temple. The TripAdvisor listing now shows the property as 'Soumya Resorts' but the kitchen, address and 300-seater dining hall are the same; reviewers consistently flag quality food and a Dalai-Lama-stayed-here history (Room 7).
insider_tip: Order Chhattisgarhi thali ahead of the standard Indian-Chinese — chausela roti and aamat are made on request only. The 300-seater hall doubles as a wedding venue on weekends; on those days food times can stretch. Call ahead: +91 77142 24999.
signature_address: Hiuen Tsiang Tourist Resort, Behind Paryatak Suchna Kendra, Near Sirpur Chowk, Sirpur, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh 493551

name: Aloha Nature Stay Restaurant
signature_dish: Tribal-flavoured veg thali with farm vegetables
why_it_matters: On-site kitchen at Aloha Nature Stay — the 20-room cottage cluster on the bank of the Sirpur River at the fringe of Barnawapara forest, ~18 minutes from Lakshmana Temple. The restaurant menu, in the property's own words, 'celebrates tribal flavours' with farm-grown organic vegetables; the only second sit-down kitchen at Sirpur after Hiuen Tsiang.
insider_tip: Confirm menu availability before ordering — the kitchen runs on what the garden gives that day. Pre-book overnight if eating dinner; lunch walk-ins from Hiuen Tsiang/Lakshmana day-trippers are accepted when staff are around. Pair with the wooden-suite cottages for the sunset over Sirpur River.
signature_address: Aloha Nature Stay, Jalki, Sirpur, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh 493445

name: Sirpur Mahotsav Food Court
signature_dish: Chausela roti and mahua-laddoo from village SHGs
why_it_matters: During the three-day Sirpur Mahotsav / Sirpur Heritage Festival (2026 confirmed for 1-3 February), the District Administration sets up a food court that stocks chausela, aamat and mahua sweets — the regional dishes that almost never make it onto local restaurant menus the rest of the year. Local vendors are given priority in stall allocation by the SADA committee.
insider_tip: Festival window only. 2026 dates are 1-3 February at Lakshmana Temple grounds. Outside this window the festival ground is empty; check the District Mahasamund or Chhattisgarh Tourism page for current-year confirmation before timing a trip around it.
signature_address: Sirpur Mahotsav grounds, near Lakshmana Temple, Sirpur, Mahasamund District, Chhattisgarh 493551
